extDescription.message: Draw right on the page you're sharing. Your ink fades away on its own. Runs entirely on your machine.
extDescription.description: Shown in the store and the browser

hintArrow.message: Drag to draw an arrow / hold Shift to snap to 45°

hintLine.message: Drag to draw a line / hold Shift to snap to 45°

hintRect.message: Drag to draw a rectangle / hold Shift for a square

hintEllipse.message: Drag to draw an ellipse / hold Shift for a circle

hintSpotlight.message: Dim everything outside the area you drag

hintText.message: Click to type / Enter to confirm / Shift+Enter for a new line

hintStep.message: Click to drop a numbered badge

hintLaser.message: The trail vanishes instantly — for pointing without leaving a mark

btnSaveTitle.message: Save this view with your drawing (Cmd/Ctrl+S)

btnFadeTitle.message: Let ink disappear on its own (F)

hintPageMode.message: You can use the page now / press H or "Back to drawing" to return / Esc to exit

hintTexting.message: Type, then Enter to confirm / Shift+Enter for a new line / Esc to cancel

hintMoving.message: Alt+drag to move what you just drew

meetingTip.message: Start inkover on the tab you're sharing — not on the meeting window itself.

meetingTipSlack.message: When sharing in a huddle, start inkover on the tab you're sharing.
